items.title: refwright
items.text:
Find the PDF, check it isn't retracted, tag it, file it. One Zotero plugin, built to look and feel like part of Zotero. No accounts, no analytics, no server, and AI is optional.

Get started View on GitHub

  • Find PDFs

Legal open-access sources in a fixed order. Wrong-paper PDFs are rejected before they are attached.

  • Retractions and citations

PubMed, Crossref and Retraction Watch. A read-only citation check against Crossref.

  • Tags

Free sources or any of 8 AI providers, with review, cleanup, learning and a Tag Manager.

  • Collections

Ranked from the papers already in each collection. Offline by default, one-step undo.

items.title: In Zotero's item pane
items.text: Three sections, one per job, with Zotero's own colours, so light and dark follow Zotero.

items.title: Review in one window
items.text:
Note

Requires Zotero 8 or later.

items.title: Write-back API
items.text: Lets another local program add or remove tags through Zotero's local server (127.0.0.1). Off by default.

items.title: Setup
items.text:
1. Zotero > Settings > Advanced: enable Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero.
  2. refwright settings: enable the API, Generate a token.
  3. Send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

items.title: Endpoints
items.text:
Endpoint Method Does /refwright/ping GET capabilities /refwright/tag POST add or remove tags; supports dryRun /refwright/audit GET newest 500 log entries /refwright/undo POST reverse one recorded write by id 
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:23119/refwright/tag \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"dryRun":true,"items":[{"key":"ABCD1234","add":["GRADE:high"]}]}'

items.title: Allowed tag prefixes
items.text:
fulltext:, retraction:, citation:, refwright:, GRADE:, RoB2:, ROBINS-I:, Quality:. Anything else is refused, even with a valid token.

View or clear the log under Tools > refwright > Write-back Audit Log. Clearing it changes no tags.

• Item pane is now three sections: Find PDFs (status, retraction and citation badges, actions), Tags (inline suggestions: click to add, × to reject, Add all) and Collections (current collections, ranked matches you click to file, Undo).
  • Every action now reports errors on screen and in the debug log instead of failing silently.
  • Docs: tabs, grid cards, per-page Lucide icons, item pane screenshots.

• Fix raw string IDs (refwright-section-row-fulltext, refwright-prefs-title) showing in the item pane and settings: the plugin now loads its main-window strings as well as its own.
  • Item pane: short action buttons (Find, Check, Suggest, File), tighter rows that follow Zotero's Info pane rhythm.
  • Settings pane: spacing stylesheet.
  • Docs workflow: separate build and deploy jobs, manual run button. Release workflow: manual run button.
• First version: PDF finder, retraction and citation checks, tagging (free and AI), Tag Manager, collection routing, write-back API.

items.title: Collections
items.text: Right-click > refwright > File into Collections… for one paper or many.

items.title: Ranking
items.text:
Offline (default)EmbeddingsLLM

Each collection is profiled from the titles, abstracts, tags and venues of the papers in it. Score = TF-IDF similarity to the profile + nearest filed neighbours + collection-name match. No key, nothing leaves your computer.

Cosine similarity between the paper and each collection, with a depth penalty. Sends the paper title and each collection's name plus the first 100 characters of its papers' titles and abstracts.

One prompt with the paper's title and abstract plus all collection names.

If a remote method fails, refwright falls back to offline ranking and says so.

items.title: Adjustments
items.text:
• Ignore collections whose name contains a word (default inbox): never suggested, and papers filed only there are not evidence.
  • Oversized catch-all collections are down-weighted.
  • A child collection is not suggested when its parent is already a strong match.
  • Chips you turn off feed a per-item blacklist; Retry re-ranks.

items.title: Review window
items.text: Each paper shows its top 5 suggestions as chips, best pre-selected. Hover for the matched words and the most similar papers filed there. Single-paper mode adds a search box (/) and a threshold slider.

items.title: Undo
items.text: refwright > Undo Last Filing reverses additions and inbox removals in one step. It survives restarts and covers the last filing only.

items.title: Install
items.text: Download the .xpi from the latest release, then in Zotero: Tools > Plugins > gear icon > Install Plugin From File.

items.title: First run
items.text:
1. Open Zotero > Settings > refwright and enter a contact email. It goes to Unpaywall, NCBI, Europe PMC, Crossref and OpenAlex, as their polite-use rules ask.
  2. Select items, right-click, refwright > Find PDFs.
  3. Results appear in one progress window. Double-click a row to jump to the item.

items.title: Where things are
items.text: Place What Item right-click > refwright PDF, retraction, citation, tag and collection actions Collection right-click Suggest tags for the whole collection Tools > refwright Tagged-batch runs, Tag Manager, CSV export, audit log, settings Item list column refwright PDF, No PDF, Check, ⚠ Retracted (sortable) Item pane section refwright Status and per-item buttons

items.title: Status tags
items.text: refwright writes fulltext:, retraction:, citation: and refwright: tags. Tagging, cleanup and the Tag Manager never touch them.

items.title: Retraction check
items.text:
PubMed (Retracted Publication type) first, then Crossref, which includes Retraction Watch. DOI-only items get a PMID through a PubMed search first.

Tags: retraction:retracted, retraction:none, retraction:check-needed.

items.title: Citation metadata check
items.text:
Compares title, year, journal, volume, issue, pages and first author with Crossref. It never changes a field.

Tags: citation:ok, citation:incomplete (fields missing), citation:mismatch (often a wrong DOI), citation:check-needed (no DOI or Crossref unreachable).

items.title: Report notes
items.text: Off by default. When on, items with problems get one child note tagged refwright:report that names each problem and its source.

items.title: Full check
items.text: refwright > Full Check runs PDF, retraction and citation checks together.

items.title: PDFs
items.text:
Open-access only. Sources run in this order and stop at the first valid PDF:

  1. Existing attachment (skipped; stale fulltext:pdf-missing and fulltext:check-needed tags cleared)
  2. Unpaywall
  3. PubMed Central
  4. Europe PMC
  5. Semantic Scholar
  6. Crossref (open-licensed links only; follows preprint links)
  7. CORE
  8. OpenAIRE (only products it rates open)
  9. Preprint servers: arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, OSF family, PeerJ Preprints, Zenodo, Figshare
  10. HAL, DOAJ, OSTI, Internet Archive Scholar
  11. OpenAlex links, then hosted full text if you set a key
  12. Internet Archive retry for dead links
  13. Free-to-read publisher pages through Zotero's own downloader (on by default)

items.title: Safety checks
items.text:
• Bytes must start with %PDF- and be 10 KB to 100 MB.
  • If the PDF's embedded DOI differs from the item's, it is not attached and the item gets fulltext:check-needed. Preprint DOIs inside a published item's PDF are tolerated.
  • Title-only items match on exact normalized title and year within 1. Near matches are never accepted.

items.title: Politeness
items.text:
3 items in parallel, 400 ms pause per host, one retry on network errors and 5xx, a 429 makes that source rest for a minute. Items with no open copy are skipped for a day. Runs over 60 items ask first. Cancel stops in-flight requests.

Tip

Preview PDF Sources shows which source would supply each PDF and changes nothing.

Tags written: fulltext:pdf-found, fulltext:pdf-missing, fulltext:check-needed. Tools > refwright > Export Missing PDFs writes a CSV for interlibrary loan.

items.title: Privacy
items.text:
No accounts, no analytics, no server of ours.

Feature What leaves your computer, and where PDFs DOI, PMID, arXiv ID or title, plus your contact email and any keys you set, to the scholarly services listed in PDFs. PDF host sites see the URL only. Retractions, citations DOI or PMID to PubMed and Crossref Free tags DOI only, to OpenAlex, PubMed, Crossref AI tags the fields you tick under What the model sees, to your chosen provider. PDF text is off by default. Tag Manager (AI scan) tag names and counts only Tag Manager (local scans) nothing Collections, offline nothing Collections, embeddings or LLM see Collections Ollama or a local custom server nothing leaves your machine

The OpenAlex key is sent in an Authorization header and never saved on an attachment. Undo history, learned tag rules and the audit log are stored locally in your profile.

items.title: AI providers
items.text:
Each provider keeps its own key, model and base URL. Test connection loads the live model list.

Provider Default model Chat Embeddings OpenAI gpt-4o-mini yes yes Anthropic claude-haiku-5-5 yes no Google Gemini gemini-3.6-flash yes yes DeepSeek deepseek-chat yes no OpenRouter openai/gpt-4o-mini yes no Cohere command-r7b-12-2024 yes yes Custom (OpenAI-compatible) your choice yes yes Ollama (local) llama3.2 yes yes

Custom works with LM Studio, vLLM, Groq and similar; the key is optional. Ollama uses http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 and needs no key.

Keys are stored in Zotero prefs and sent only to the provider's base URL.

items.title: Settings
items.text:
Zotero > Settings > refwright. All preferences live under extensions.zotero.refwright.*.

Group Options General contact email, batch tag (default refwright), report note, preview only, remember misses, show column, show item pane section PDF sources per-source checkboxes, Internet Archive retry, publisher pages, title lookup, fill DOI, record OpenAlex ID, OpenAlex/CORE/Semantic Scholar keys, hosted text AI provider, model, key, base URL, embedding provider and model, temperature, max tokens, timeout, items per request, JSON mode Tags method, free sources, review, seeds, language, prompt, marker tag, automatic tags, skip tagged What the model sees title, abstract, authors, journal, date, existing tags, DOI, PDF text and length, share library tags Tag cleanup every rule listed in Tags Collections ranking mode, ignore words, minimum confidence, collections per paper, remove from inbox Tag Manager AI scan tags per request and requests per scan Write-back API enable, token (generate, copy, test)

Hidden preferences: concurrency (1 to 6) and delayMs.

items.title: Methods
items.text:
FreeAI

No AI, no key. Results go through the same cleanup and review as AI tags, and each tag shows its source.

  1. Your library: TF-IDF similarity against already-tagged items; the 8 nearest vote and tags carried by at least 2 are proposed. Needs 30+ tagged items (configurable). Offline.
  2. OpenAlex (DOI): keywords above a minimum score plus the broad subfield.
  3. PubMed (DOI): MeSH headings and author keywords. Biomedical only.
  4. Crossref (DOI): journal subjects. Often empty, off by default.
  5. Keywords: repeated phrases from title and abstract, only where lookups found nothing.

Item metadata goes to the provider you choose. See AI providers and Privacy.

items.title: Review
items.text: Tags appear in one window per batch. Click a chip to toggle it, × to reject, type to add. Collection suggestions share the same window.

items.title: Steering
items.text: Seed keywords, only-seeds mode, tag language, custom prompt, marker tag, automatic (gray) tags, skip already-tagged items.

items.title: Cleanup
items.text: Remove slashes and odd characters, merge duplicates (case, spacing, plurals), reuse the spelling of existing library tags, letter case, separator, max tags (8), max words (4), max length (40), prefix, blacklist, replacement rules (ML -> machine learning).

items.title: Learning from your edits
items.text: A tag you remove twice (net of times you kept it) stops appearing. A replacement you make twice is applied automatically. Deselecting a whole item teaches nothing. Stored in the profile, not synced.

items.title: Tag Manager
items.text:
Tools > refwright > Tag Manager. Nothing changes until you merge, and every change can be undone.

  • Duplicates (local): case, plurals, typos, word order, abbreviations.
  • Formatting (local): tags that break your cleanup rules.
  • Similar meaning (AI): sends tag names and counts only. Shows a token estimate first.
  • All tags: search, sort, filter, bulk rename, merge, delete.

The merge target is the most-used tag; ties go to the shorter name, then alphabetical.
